enabled.description: Enable or disable the low memory monitor.

interval.description: Time in seconds between consecutive memory checks.

min_free_mb.description: Minimum free memory in megabytes below which the monitor triggers an alert.

min_free_percent.description: Minimum free memory percentage (0–100) below which the monitor triggers an alert.

actions.description: List of actions to execute when low memory is detected. Each action defines the type and target.

type.description: Action type: log (append message to log), notify (send system notification), kill (terminate process), or reboot (reboot system).

target.description: Target of the action: for 'notify' (e.g., 'systemd', 'notify-send'), for 'kill' (e.g., 'lowest_oom_score' or 'highest_oom_score'), for 'reboot' (ignored), for 'log' (ignored).

args.description: Additional colon-separated arguments (e.g., 'threshold=1000' for notify or 'max_retries=3' for reboot).

log_file.description: Path to log file (use '-' to log to stdout).

kill_threshold.description: Minimum OOM score adjustment below which processes are protected from being killed (range: -1000 to +1000; lower = more protected).

max_kills.description: Maximum number of processes to kill per low-memory event (0 = no limit).

pid_whitelist.description: List of process IDs to never kill (e.g., [1] for init).

protected_patterns.description: List of regex patterns. Processes matching any pattern will never be killed.

memory_pressure_threshold.description: Memory pressure rate (in kbps) above which aggressive actions (e.g., more aggressive kill policies) are triggered. 0 = disable memory pressure monitoring.

disable_oom_killer.description: Disable the kernel OOM killer (dangerous — may lead to system deadlock).
